title: Travel: John Lennon – Paris to London | 1970
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono flew from Paris to London on 26 January 1970.

They had flown to France the previous day. Their original plan was to fly to Luton Airport in England, but heavy fog meant their flight was diverted to Paris.

They spent the night at the Paris Hilton hotel, and on this day went shopping at the Pierre Cardin boutique. They returned to England in the evening.
